evidence.summary: Phase 1 canonical contracts and protocol assets were included in the first complete RMP implementation pushed to main.
Phases 0-5 are marked complete and establish the tested offline-first toolkit baseline.
The design defers provider authentication, hosted collaboration, portfolio aggregation, signed receipts, and bidirectional provider writes.
RMP now renders delivery as a horizontal output schedule and releases as an evidence-backed chronology, enabling its own post-MVP roadmap to use the protocol.

rmp/strategy.anchor: Grow RMP from a reliable repository-local protocol into connected, collaborative roadmap infrastructure without creating a second source of truth.
assumptions: Repositories remain the canonical owner of roadmap state.
Provider integrations can preserve provenance without storing credentials in roadmap files.
rmp/strategy.baseline: The offline-first toolkit and visual roadmap are shipped; live provider evidence, collaboration, portfolio aggregation, and verifiable cross-machine changes remain unvalidated.
deferrals: Provider writeback remains blocked until connected evidence and verifiable history are proven.
nextActions: Choose the Phase 6 reference provider and validate authentication, pagination, retry, and provenance.
Define status vocabulary, visual treatment, filters, and valid transitions for every roadmap view.
openQuestions: Which provider should be the Phase 6 reference connector?
Which collaboration jobs genuinely require a hosted service?
risks: Hosted collaboration could weaken repository authority or create divergent state.
Provider writeback could create irreversible or duplicated external changes.
